subject: S-02

subject: S-02
question: what "Staff permissions" takes its value per

Salla's market restriction of a role (S02-SA-100) and the store-wide permissions of the others answer there.

CM-STF-002's BigCommerce cell is none-held (searched permission, role, user permissions, access level), and CM-STF-001's BigCommerce cell is core on staff accounts whose users are not stated with permissions (BC-S-0333). subject: S-02

reading: A reading: who grants a staff member a permission is CM-STF-002's thing (roles and permissions, by the owner, an administrator, or a role that may edit others); the Markets permission itself is evidence for CM-MKS-001, whose Shopify cell cites VIEW_MARKETS among the Markets section's eligibility, as CM-STF-002's note assigns each permission to the capability it gates.

CM-STF-002's WooCommerce cell is core only (WC-C-080/where/WC-S-0883, WC-C-080/decides/WC-S-5415, WC-C-080/boundary/WC-S-5418), with no extension-point. subject: S-02

S02-BC-327, S02-BC-328 and S02-BC-329 state BigCommerce's own setting Allow global logins (allow_global_login), set for each channel in the control panel, which decides whether a customer created on one storefront may enter another: its own setting, core. CM-MKS-001's BigCommerce cell is none-held (no statement held groups its settings as a market), and CM-MKS-004's BigCommerce cell is core on the transactional currency by country only (BC-C-074/decides/BC-S-0402). subject: S-02

subject: S-02

reading: A reading: the business address is a store detail, CM-ACC-006's (WooCommerce's general settings, Zid's basic store information, BigCommerce's global store_address_type); Shopify takes it in its business entity's form and store address (S02-SH-324, S02-SH-342), which CM-ACC-004 holds. subject: S-02

reading: A reading: cookie preferences are CM-TRU-006's thing, the visitors' cookie consent and privacy settings, which the seller configures and the buyer accepts on each platform's own banner or setting, and which WooCommerce leaves to an extension.
